verdict.rationale: Gitea is a self-hosted Git service, so registering SSH keys for Git authentication is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents adding or managing SSH keys on a user account. The only SSH mention is a community user reaching the web UI through SSH port forwarding, which is a user-side workaround, not account SSH-key authentication.

support.subject: As a developer, I can register SSH keys on my account to authenticate Git operations
